title: Phoneme pack
description: PROP-9: a language's phoneme inventory as data (packs/<id>.json), served by the API and bundled in each client. A Piece names its pack in system.phonology (absent = hindi-urdu). Syllables (PROP-8) store pack KEYS in onset/nucleus/coda/tone; IPA and display forms are derived from the pack, never stored on the syllable.

packVersion.description: Semver of the pack data, independent of the contract version. A key is never removed or renamed within a major.

keyScheme.description: What a key is (which romanization the syllable stores).

scripts.description: ISO 15924 codes that `display` maps may carry.

unverified.description: Paths or statements in this pack that are not yet checked by a speaker or phonetician. Clients may show them; they must not treat them as settled.

syllabicNasals.description: A syllable may have no nucleus when its final is listed with syllabic: true (Jyutping m, ng).

onsetClusters.description: onset may be an array of consonant keys.

codaClusters.description: coda may be an array of coda keys.

tones.description: The pack defines `tones`; a syllable's tone must be one of its keys.

nucleusOptional.description: A syllable may have no nucleus (hindi-urdu: healed legacy groups with no vowel).

legacyExact.description: Every `legacy` block is exact (the projection is lossless for this pack's keys). Only hindi-urdu.

consonants.description: Onset consonants (and codas when `codas` is "consonants"), keyed by pack key.

codas.description: Coda inventory: the string "consonants" to reuse `consonants`, or its own map (Jyutping: -p -t -k are unreleased, -i -u are glides).

vowels.description: Nucleus vowels keyed by pack key.

finals.description: Vowel-realization table for languages where the nucleus quality depends on the coda (Jyutping). Key = nucleus key + coda key. When present, a syllable's (nucleus, coda) must be a listed final.

chao.description: Chao tone letters as digits 1-5, e.g. "55", "25".

legacyTables.description: hindi-urdu only: the eight arrays compiled into the pre-0.3.0 clients, verbatim, so the `legacy` blocks can be checked against them.

legacy.description: What the PROP-8 projection writes into the pre-0.3.0 per-trajectory fields for this key. Exact for hindi-urdu ({iso, hindi, ipa, engTrans} = today's tables at indexOf(iso)); for other packs only `iso`, the nearest hindi-urdu key, marked approximate, and the copies come from that hindi-urdu entry.

placeholder.description: Not a vowel: a stored placeholder (hindi-urdu '_').
